meetingNotes.notes: Bodies are Notion AI meeting-note blocks with a summary and a transcript. The summary may not come back through the tools.

fathom._comment: Fallback for meeting summaries when Notion has none. Needs FATHOM_API_KEY. Leave recordedBy empty to search everyone's recordings (calls are often run by Nick, Ella, etc.); matching uses the contacts' email domains and exact emails.

superhuman._comment: Tom's mailbox via Superhuman Mail MCP, used only by Ask. Only these read tools are enabled; send/draft/trash/label/event tools are never exposed. A sign-in is accepted only if it includes expectedAccount.
